designThesis: Northline is a make-slot desk, not a boutique shelf: open on the Field Tote product plate with trade facts stamped on the plate edge; the argument is graded hide + a three-week make-slot request — never lifestyle hero, purple SaaS gradient, or star ratings.
contentHierarchy: material stamp facts (bridle / veg tan / solid brass)
Belt No. 2 plate + Shoulder Strap text until plate exists — no testimonials, no fake star rows.
pageComposition: single object left, large type right

typographySystem.principle: Display: Barlow Condensed 600–700 for product names (workshop signage, tight tracking). Body: IBM Plex Sans 400–500 plain trade English 45–75ch. Utility: IBM Plex Mono for hide grade codes, stitch count when known, lead time, prices. No luxury serif display.

colourRoles.ground: Warm cream ground; ink-brown type and rules; hide-mid secondary; brass only on CTA and hardware callouts; edge-bone plate rails; deep soot borders. Materials: bridle leather, solid brass, vegetable tan. No purple multi-stop SaaS gradients.
colourRoles.text: primary ink on ground with WCAG AA body contrast

surfaceMaterialModel: open — subject earns space around the object
imageryStrategy: Load-bearing product plates field-tote.webp and belt-no-2.webp on cream grounds, no model crops. stitch-macro.webp as single proof inset only when available (needed). Shoulder Strap as text+price until a plate exists. Deliberately no lifestyle models or stock handshakes.
componentPrinciples: states must be visible without colour alone
primary action uses reserved accent only

motionRules.principle: Hide Grade Strip as accessible radiogroup under the primary plate; selection darkens plate edge rail and updates make-slot summary. Motion intensity 2: only ~120–180ms edge response on hide change; prefers-reduced-motion = instant swap. Primary CTA: Request make-slot. No scroll-jacking.

responsiveBehavior.firstFold: preserve composition intent; stack only after tablet
responsiveBehavior.tables: horizontal scroll must expose affordance if used

accessibilityConstraints: AA contrast for body and UI text
signatureElement: Hide Grade Strip — horizontal hide-grade chips (material swatch wells + ink-brown labels) under the Field Tote plate; the single memorable control that ties plate → grade → make-slot.
forbiddenFallbackDefaults: three equal feature cards as default identity
round-8 recipe: mono uppercase labels + hairlines + tabular motif + flat depth

fidelityAssertions.expected: single object left, large type right
